backup.procedure: Drain and close store, execute CHECKPOINT through the owned port, close the port, require WAL absence, and copy to exclusive backup and restore paths.
backup.reopened_target: Matched typed history and receipts, replayed both original batch commands exactly, and persisted the healthy next write at position 3.

torn_wal.phase: After writing uncommitted WAL records and before WAL_FLUSH, during explicit COMMIT.
torn_wal.reopened_target: Matched the last committed history and 36 typed cuts, excluded the interrupted receipt, and matched the staged receipt on exact retry at position 3.

open_failure_modes: Filesystem ENOSPC on database or WAL write
